test_origin: All 50 test records are from the newly supplied 80-record A2/R3 DOCX extension; none was used to fit or evaluate the original 250 model.
split_policy: Deterministic hash/whole lexical-family assignment; five entirely new test records and five original-pool dev records per label; cross-label families kept in train. No model predictions used to choose splits.
model_settings: Unchanged Colab official baseline: character TF-IDF ngrams 2–5 and LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000,random_state=42). No tuning planned.
comparison: After freezing: evaluate original frozen 250 model and newly trained model on the SAME new 50-record holdout, once. Historical 49/50 score remains a separate previous test.
old_test_reuse: Some records in the former 250 test may now be train/dev. This is a NEW experiment with a wholly new holdout, not a fresh claim about the old test.
colab_text_policy: User-edited Colab copied byte-for-byte and not changed online; training code extracted from its embedded project.
source_evidence: Team-user confirmations of human authorship, R1/R2/R3 independent competent review and author permission for datathon use/sharing. Actual review dates unspecified.
limitation: Lexical grouping does not guarantee detection of all semantic paraphrases. Small, one-author new holdout is not field validation.
